head: Draw a finished, fully detailed stylized island for a 3D model, using the attached image as a rough guide for its overall shape and layout. Exact outline is NOT required: keep the general shape, but make the landmass SOLID. Hard rules: no holes, no gaps, no notches, no see-through openings anywhere in the land or the rocks; trees stand on solid ground that continues under them; every rock is solid and touches the ground; the background never shows through. Layout:
tail: Camera about 30 degrees above the horizon, same orientation as the guide. Sharp faceted rock, readable individual trees, clean sand edges, crisp flat shading, no blur, no noise. Flat neutral mid-grey background (#AAAEB2), nothing else: no water, no sky, no ground shadow, no text. Stylized low-poly handpainted game art, bright saturated colours, soft daylight from the upper left. The island fills most of the frame.

isle_02: a wide tropical lagoon island made of low sandy lobes curving around a sheltered lagoon that opens toward the viewer; dense palm trees and a few broadleaf trees on the sand; two wooden stilt huts with thatched roofs on short wooden piers at the inner shore; small green rocky knolls at both ends joined to the main sand by spits.
isle_03: a large hilly green island; on the right side a tall cliff face of grey stone in vertical strata dropping to the sea; on the highest point at the back left a ruined round stone watchtower; slopes covered with conifers and patches of meadow with a winding dirt path; a sandy cove with boulders on the near left; a small solid rock headland at the lower right.
isle_04: a desert island of golden sand; several tall reddish-orange sandstone mesas and rock pillars with layered horizontal bands; on the right half a small ruined sand-coloured fortress town with square towers; a few palm trees; a rocky reddish shore.
isle_05: a harbour island: a green hill with conifers and grey rock outcrops on the left half with a small stone fort on its top; along the right shore a harbour town of houses with red tiled roofs; wooden piers and a small stone quay on the right with two small boats moored; a white lighthouse with a red top at the far right tip.
isle_06: a green island with a wide crescent beach of pale sand curving around a bay on the near side; behind it forested hills with conifers and broadleaf trees and a few grey rock outcrops; rocky points at the left and right ends of the beach.
isle_07: a long, low, flat sandy islet curving to the right into a thin sand spit; a row of palm trees along its whole length; low grey rocks at both ends; a small shallow cove on the right.
isle_08: a rugged snowy mountain island: two sharp grey peaks with snow-capped tops and snow streaks down the slopes; three small wooden houses with steep snowy roofs at the foot on the left; a rocky snow-dusted shoreline with boulders.
isle_09: a small round green islet: grassy top with two tall palm trees and several bushy broadleaf trees, low grey rock cliffs around the near side, a small sandy cove at the front.
isle_10: a wedge-shaped green islet rising to the left: grassy top with conifers and leafy trees, steep grey rock cliffs on the near side, broken rocks stepping down to the sea at the right tip.
isle_11: two low islets side by side: on the left a small rounded green knoll with trees and grey rocks; on the right a long low sandy strip with a row of palm trees and a shallow cove. Two separate pieces are fine; each piece is solid.
isle_13: a grassy islet with a tall ruined stone watchtower standing at the back left; a gentle grassy slope with scattered bushes and a few rocks; low grey cliffs on the near side with a strip of sand at the front right.
isle_14: a flat grassy plateau islet with three broadleaf trees and a conifer; low grey rock cliffs all around its edge; a rocky tail running out to the lower right.
isle_17: a cluster of bare grey rock spires dusted with snow, in two groups side by side: a wider group of several jagged spires on the left and one taller pointed spire on the right; no trees. Two separate pieces are fine; each piece is solid.
isle_18: a long low grassy islet with a small square stone ruin standing in the middle right, a few scattered trees, low grey rocks along the shore and a strip of sand on the near side.
volcano: a large volcanic island: a tall dark basalt volcano cone in the middle with a glowing orange-red crater at the top and deep ridged slopes, smaller dark peaks around it, lower foothills with patches of green vegetation and golden sand at the base, a rocky dark shoreline. IMPORTANT: unlike the guide, which is seen almost from the side, show it from about 30 degrees above so the island's footprint is visible.
